clues: This coast city in the north east of its land faces a wide sea. The sea lies to the south of its streets and fields.
More than half of all the rain of the year falls in just two months. July and August bring most of the wet days to this town.
In 1976 a huge quake shook this city flat to the ground. It took the lives of a vast throng of folk, and the town had to be built anew.
This land got its first steam train from this town, and its first cement works too. Folk call the place a cradle of its new works and crafts.
Ping opera, a loved form of song and dance on stage, first grew up near here. It is one of the five most loved such arts in the whole land.
